claims: The 2026 Masters final round is on Sunday, April 12.
CBS provides final round coverage of the 2026 Masters from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET.
Paramount+ provides early coverage of the 2026 Masters final round from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m.
Paramount+ provides main coverage of the 2026 Masters final round from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m.
Free streaming is available on Masters.com and the Masters App for the 2026 Masters.
Masters.com and the Masters App provide featured groups coverage for the 2026 Masters.
Masters.com and the Masters App provide Amen Corner coverage for the 2026 Masters.
Masters.com and the Masters App provide holes 15/16 coverage for the 2026 Masters.
Masters.com and the Masters App provide the main broadcast for the 2026 Masters.
Paid streaming for the 2026 Masters is available on Paramount+, YouTube TV, DirecTV Stream, ESPN App, and Prime Video.
Amen Corner coverage for the 2026 Masters is available on Masters.com, Paramount+, and ESPN App.
Holes 15 and 16 coverage for the 2026 Masters is available on Masters.com, Paramount+, and ESPN App.
Featured Groups coverage for the 2026 Masters is from 10:15 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET on Sunday, April 12.
Amen Corner coverage for the 2026 Masters is from 11:45 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET on Sunday, April 12.
The Green Jacket Ceremony for the 2026 Masters is at 7 p.m. ET on Masters.com.
Free coverage on Masters.com is limited to users with a US IP address.
Access to free coverage on Masters.com from abroad requires a VPN.
